::: {#exr-two-features-ten-digits}

#### Two features for ten digits

Describe each image by the two [features](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/course-overview.html#def-feature) so far,
its center ink and its left ink.
Classify each image as the digit whose average pair of features,
over all the images of that digit,
is nearest to the image's own pair.
How much larger is the share of images this classifier gets right
than the share that always guessing the most common digit gets right?

:::
